papers.title: High-Pressure XRD Study of Ti-3Al-2.5V Titanium Alloy: Intermediate Transition Pressure and Composition Trends in Ti-Al-V Alloys
papers.abstract: High-pressure X-ray diffraction experiments were performed on Ti-Al-V alloys to investigate the effect of composition on structural stability, focusing on Ti-3Al-2.5V and comparing with pure Titanium and Ti-6Al-4V. Measurements using different pressure-transmitting media show a phase transition in Ti-3Al-2.5V at 17-19 GPa, intermediate between pure Ti (5-10 GPa) and Ti-6Al-4V (~30 GPa). Despite variations arising from the choice of pressure medium, the transition pressure shows a clear and systematic increase with higher Al and V content. Equation-of-state analysis indicates that the bulk modulus remains nearly unchanged across compositions. This suggests a decoupling between elastic properties and phase stability, with alloying primarily affecting the transition pressure rather than compressibility. These results highlight the role of composition in tuning high-pressure phase transformations in Ti-Al-V based alloys.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ti-3Al-2.5V合金的高压相变，与Ti-6Al-4V后处理及热等静压（HIP）无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address any post-processing methods, HIP, or mechanical property improvement for Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究Al和V含量对Ti-Al-V合金高压相稳定性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过高压X射线衍射实验测量Ti-3Al-2.5V在不同压力介质下的相变。
summary_zh.result: 发现Ti-3Al-2.5V相变压力介于纯Ti和Ti-6Al-4V之间，且随合金含量增加而升高。
summary_zh.validation: 实验数据与纯Ti和Ti-6Al-4V结果对比验证趋势。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how Al and V content affect the high-pressure phase stability of Ti-Al-V alloys.
summary_en.method: High-pressure X-ray diffraction experiments were conducted on Ti-3Al-2.5V using different pressure-transmitting media.
summary_en.result: The phase transition pressure of Ti-3Al-2.5V (17-19 GPa) is intermediate between pure Ti and Ti-6Al-4V, showing a clear compositional dependence.
summary_en.validation: Results are compared with pure Ti and Ti-6Al-4V to confirm compositional trends.

papers.title: Frustrated Magnetism of the $S = 1$ Trillium-Lattice Oxide Li$_2$NiGe$_3$O$_8$
papers.abstract: We report magnetization and heat-capacity measurements on the ordered-spinel oxide Li$_2$NiGe$_3$O$_8$, where Ni$^{2+}$ ions with $S = 1$ form a single three-dimensional trillium lattice. Powder x-ray diffraction confirms a cubic ordered-spinel structure with space group $P4_{1}32$ or $P4_{3}32$. The inverse susceptibility $H/M$ follows Curie--Weiss behavior above 50 K with an effective magnetic moment $μ_{\mathrm{eff}} = 3.124(4)\,μ_{\mathrm{B}}$ per Ni and a Weiss temperature $θ_{\mathrm{W}} = -0.21(1)$ K, but deviates smoothly below about 10 K. The magnetic heat capacity $C_{\mathrm{mag}}/T$ shows a broad maximum near 3 K with a wide tail to about 10 K, and the entropy recovered between 2 and 40 K is about 88% of $R \ln 3$. The broad heat-capacity maximum is compared with Monte Carlo results for the local ferromagnetic Ising model on the trillium lattice using a characteristic scale $J$ of order 7 K, while the inverse susceptibility shows only qualitative similarity to the theoretical curve. These results establish Li$_2$NiGe$_3$O$_8$ as a rare $S = 1$ single-trillium oxide with frustrated magnetic correlations. The present data provide an experimental platform for discussing the relation between Heisenberg-like and spin-ice-like regimes on the trillium lattice.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向完全无关，属于凝聚态物理。
llm.why_not_core: This is a condensed matter physics paper on frustrated magnetism with no relevance to additive manufacturing, biomedical implants, finite element analysis, or bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究罕见S=1三叶草晶格氧化物的磁性。
summary_zh.method: 通过磁化率和热容测量，与蒙特卡罗模拟对比。
summary_zh.result: 确认Li2NiGe3O8为阻挫磁体，展示了Heisenberg与自旋冰行为的关系。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量与蒙特卡罗模拟定性比较。

summary_en.motivation: This paper aims to characterize the magnetic properties of Li2NiGe3O8 as a rare S=1 single-trillium oxide with frustrated magnetic correlations.
summary_en.method: Magnetization and heat capacity measurements were performed, and the heat capacity was compared with Monte Carlo results for the local ferromagnetic Ising model on the trillium lattice.
summary_en.result: The compound exhibits a broad heat-capacity maximum near 3 K and Curie-Weiss behavior above 50 K, establishing it as a frustrated magnet.
summary_en.validation: Experimental data were compared qualitatively with Monte Carlo simulations for the Ising model on the same lattice.

papers.title: Definition of Femoral Morphotypes Based on the Coronal Plane Alignment of the Hip Classification.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In total hip arthroplasty (THA), accurate reconstruction of physiological joint biomechanics is determined by the individual patient's proximal femoral anatomy and stem design. Previous studies demonstrated a wide variation of femoral canal shapes and an association with extramedullary geometrical features. The purpose of this study was to propose a comprehensive classification for the coronal plane alignment of the hip (CPAH) that incorporates intramedullary and extramedullary parameters. We sought to determine the distribution of femoral morphotypes in an osteoarthritic cohort and to assess the reconstructive potential of four common femoral stem designs in each CPAH type. METHODS: The preoperative radiographs of 2,345 patients undergoing primary uncemented THA were retrospectively analyzed, including Dorr classification, neck-shaft angle (NSA), femoral offset (FO), and femoral offset ratio (FOR). The CPAH classification defines nine morphotypes based on the combination of Dorr type and NSA. Each morphotype is categorized into a normal- and a high-offset subgroup. Digital templating was conducted to assess the reconstruction of FO, leg length (LL), and the agreement between anatomy and stem geometry. RESULTS: The CPAH types 2N, 5N, 5H, 6N, and 8N accounted for a combined percentage of 82% (n = 1,928), whereas the remaining morphotypes represented less common anatomical constitutions. Canal shape, FO, and NSA were associated with demographic characteristics (age, P < 0.001; sex, P < 0.001). Subgroup analyses stratified by CPAH types revealed that the reconstructive potential of each stem design depends on the patient's femoral morphotype. Across all CPAH types, the short stem was the best-fit implant, whereas a mismatch between anatomy and stem design was evident in up to 80% of the cases using the anatomic stem design. CONCLUSIONS: The CPAH classification provides a comprehensive classification system for femoral morphotypes. It enables a phenotyping approach in THA planning and provides practical guidance for individualized implant selection.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于髋关节置换术中的股骨形态分类和假体选择，未涉及增材制造或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing, finite element analysis, or surrogate modeling is presented; the study is a retrospective clinical classification without biomechanical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出一种包含髓内和髓外参数的股骨形态分类系统以指导假体选择。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析2345例THA患者X线片，结合Dorr分型和颈干角定义九种形态类型。
summary_zh.result: 短柄假体适配性最优，解剖型假体不匹配率高达80%。
summary_zh.validation: 基于大样本临床数据的回顾性分析。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a comprehensive femoral morphotype classification incorporating both intramedullary and extramedullary parameters for improved total hip arthroplasty planning.
summary_en.method: A retrospective review of 2,345 preoperative radiographs classified femurs into nine morphotypes by combining Dorr type and neck-shaft angle, with digital templating of four stem designs.
summary_en.result: Short stems showed the best fit across morphotypes, while anatomic stems had mismatch rates up to 80%.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through a large retrospective clinical cohort without experimental testing.

key_terms.en: coronal plane alignment of the hip (CPAH)
